item.title: Calgary's ARC Resources gets pummelled on stock market despite strong earnings report
item.description: Alberta-based ARC Resources Ltd. suffered investor backlash in the stock market Friday — its shares falling as much as 13 per cent — after reporting a setback at one of its most significant future projects. The revelation overshadowed ARC’s otherwise strong earnings report, which showed the company produced an average of close to 408,400 barrels […]
